description: rules.yaml DECLARES the benchmark equal-weighted, but benchmark_returns.csv is in fact the cap-weighted index of the universe (the prices and the universe are delivered, so the equal-weight universe can be computed and differs from the benchmark by several pp a year). The declaration is contradicted by data.
reviewer_note: Firm: the check can contrast the declaration (it computes the equal-weight universe itself); docs/CONVENTIONS.md s.5 forbids a PASS that rests only on the owner's declaration when it can.
